name: 2018 S. Calumet Avenue — the alley building of the house at 2018 (district draft; refined by T-1941)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads '2-storey brick building on the alley lettered GARAGE, with a 1-storey piece at its south end'. The Wheeler-Kohn barn: 'To Rent — 2018 Calumet-av., large brick barn, suitable for garage' (Tribune, 24 May 1911).

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2982, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1941 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 35x trace (s35xfp-calumet_2018-b2), the T-2982 census (s35x-2018-rear) and the T-1837 register row frontage-35x-2018; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-district-edges-2982).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-2982 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 2018 S. Calumet Avenue, parcel calumet_2018 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Calumet Avenue, the district's named context buildings off Prairie Avenue: East Twentieth Street between Indiana and Prairie, and Calumet Avenue between 20th and 21st Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 35).
position.note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 1.000, v -7.250 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the sheet: the sheet's georeference carries no independent check: its own fit residual is 0.05 m RMS on its control crossings, a similarity on two degrees of freedom that says little away from them, plus about a pixel (0.19 m) of trace on this coarser copy. Rotation -0.62 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.

derivation.reason: The four derivation methods re-derive from the 1835 files; this position is re-derived from the traced sheet and the 1904 parcel by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py --check instead.

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: The census reading '2-storey brick building on the alley lettered GARAGE, with a 1-storey piece at its south end': 2 storeys.

construction.note: The trace's fabric colour on the main part: brick.

parts.from: s35xfp-calumet_2018-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 79% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): s35xfp-calumet_2018-b2 outline (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 79% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: The register's Second Empire envelope: the mansard over the brick body, its rear range as the sheet draws it. The copper bay, the limestone porch, the dormers' shapes and the high stoop are T-1941's. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 1015337546 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-district-edges-2982.
